Now set up the runtime test. Steps:

1. Create database app_db.
2. Start a local HTTP server on some port (e.g., 8899) serving an HTML page with title, meta description, favicon link, and correct Content-Type/Content-Length.
3. Start the jar in background.
4. Poll readiness.
5. Run curl/python tests.

I'll use tools.process.start for the jar and the test HTTP server. Let me write a small python test server to the scratchpad... actually scratchpad is for files; I can just use python3 -c inline or write a script to /tmp. Let me write a small python server script to /tmp/testserver.py.

The test server should serve:
- `/page` → HTML with `<title>  Test Page Title  </title>`, `<meta name="description" content="A test description">`, `<link rel="shortcut icon" href="/favicon.ico">`, Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8, Content-Length set.
- `/notitle` → HTML without title/meta/favicon.

Then tests:
- login as user1 → token
- POST /api/links/preview {"url": "http://127.0.0.1:8899/page"} → expect code 200, message "预览生成成功", data.title "Test Page Title", description, faviconUrl "/favicon.ico", data.id non-null
- POST /api/links/preview {"url": "ftp://x"} → code 400, message "URL必须以http://或https://开头", data null
- POST /api/links/preview {"url": "http://127.0.0.1:9/nonexistent"} (unreachable) → "预览生成失败", title null, id non-null
- POST /api/resources/fetch {"url": "http://127.0.0.1:8899/page", "noteId": null} → "资源获取成功", status SUCCESS, statusCode 200, contentType contains text/html, contentLength > 0, id non-null
- POST /api/resources/fetch {"url": "notaurl"} → 400 error
- POST /api/resources/fetch {"url": "http://127.0.0.1:9/x"} → "资源获取失败", status FAILED, contentLength 0, contentType null, errorMessage non-null
- GET /api/resources → list with rows
